answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every new agent to stake reputation earned through verifiable work, not just self-asserted identity. A trusted beacon service publishes a rotating roster of agents with proven task history, so a flood of fresh clones has no standing. Honest agents gather around a shared oasis of attested compute and payments, while a trellis of cross-checks, where independent verifiers confirm each others work, makes fake identities expensive to maintain and easy to prune.
